entries.note: 快件电子信息已经收到: the waybill's information reached DpdEx, before it has the parcel.
快件到达分拨中心: the parcel reached DpdEx's hub in Shenzhen.

entries.wording: Your parcel has left the depot and is on its way to airport
entries.note: 快件已离开分拨中心: left the hub for the airport.
快件出口报关中: export clearance under way.
快件出口报关放行: export clearance done.

entries.wording: Your parcel arrive at international airports
entries.note: 快件抵达国际机场: handed to the airline.
快件航班起飞: the flight left.

entries.wording: We have received the details for this parcel and expect it to reach the Evri network shortly
entries.note: Evri's label, relayed when DpdEx books a parcel for the United Kingdom.
